title: PHP Versions
desc: Add or remove PHP versions on the server. Each version runs in its own PHP-FPM pool and can be selected per domain. Installation includes 14 packages (fpm, cli, mysqlnd, mbstring, bcmath, intl, gd, soap, opcache, pdo, xml, zip, pgsql, ldap).
install_confirm: 14 packages will be installed for PHP {{version}} ({{source}}) (fpm + cli + mysqlnd + 12 extensions). Continue?
appstream_remove_blocked: AppStream is the PHP system default and cannot be removed
remove_confirm:
PHP {{version}} (Remi) and ALL its extensions will be REMOVED.
If any domain uses this version, the operation will be rejected. Continue?
